hints: To find the object from the image, subtract the vector.
Subtracting a negative is the same as adding.
common_mistakes: Applied the vector forwards when it had to be undone
Sign slip when subtracting a negative coordinate
learning_objective: Determine the column vector of a translation.
exam_skill: Subtract object coordinates from image coordinates, and reverse the process when the object is unknown
